title: Brick Bash
description: Bounce the ball off your paddle and smash every brick on the screen. Each level adds more rows and tougher bricks that need two hits.
instructions: Move the paddle with the arrow keys, A and D, or the mouse.
On touch screens, drag your finger to move the paddle.
Press Space or tap to launch the ball.
Clear all bricks to reach the next level. Press P to pause.
